policies.policy_name: Admin kab kota can manage own pengurus
Admin kab_kota can manage pengurus in their region
Admin kab_kota can update profiles in their region
Admin kab_kota can view profiles in their region
Admin provinsi can manage all pengurus
Admin provinsi can update all profiles
Admin provinsi can view all profiles
Admins can view all verification logs
Admins can view auth event logs
Authors can delete their own replies
Authors can delete their own topics
Authors can update their own replies
Authors can update their own topics
Evaluators can manage scores for their evaluations
Evaluators can update their draft evaluations
Evaluators can view their own evaluations
Public can insert auth event logs (restricted)
policies.with_check_expression: ((("event" = ANY (ARRAY['AUTH_LOGIN'::"text", 'AUTH_LOGOUT'::"text", 'AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET'::"text", 'AUTH_LOGIN_FAILED'::"text"])) AND ("success" = ANY (ARRAY[true, false])) AND ((("user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("auth"."uid"() = "user_id")) OR (("user_id" IS NULL) AND ("identifier_hash" IS NOT NULL)))))

policies.using_expression:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM "public"."evaluations" "e"
  WHERE (("e"."id" = "evaluation_scores"."evaluation_id") AND ("public"."is_admin"("auth"."uid"()) OR ("e"."evaluator_id" = "auth"."uid"()) OR (("e"."referee_id" = "auth"."uid"()) AND ("e"."status" = 'submitted'::"text")))))))
